reconstruction.scope: Individual St Bavo's Cathedral, Ghent: stepped pale stone west tower with deeply pointed entrance, large lower window, middle paired lancet tiers, tall upper field, four89m corner pinnacles and smaller dark central crown; no long central needle. Long slate-roofed nave/polygonal eastern choir with tall pointed clerestory, lean aisles, low irregular chapel ring/ranges, high transept with four46m turrets and two smaller western stair turrets.
